note: U4 producer contract (CLAUDE_CIO_US_CRYPTO_REGIME_GAP_DIAGNOSIS_20260914 sec. 3 U4). This file ratifies nothing and adds no number. It pins the already-ratified identities the US PAPER runtime consumes and the shapes of the three artifacts a later CIO technical adoption (U5) must bind. Until config/us_paper_runtime_adoption_v1.json exists, is active, and binds a US PIT_ACCEPTED acceptance record and an official session calendar, every decision is UNKNOWN.

normalization.note: The diagnosis cites 'ba82906a' for the US normalization block. That is the git commit (PR #670) that ratified the file; the file bytes are unchanged since. The US block must also equal markets.US of config/paper_regime_reference_policy_v1.json, whose thresholds regime.paper_regime_reference.build_us executes.

axis_rules.arithmetic: regime.paper_regime_reference.build_us (unmodified) over the committed free_market_data_capture/5 packet

session_based_axes.freshness: regime.regime_semantic_freshness.evaluate_axis_freshness SESSION_EXACT_MATCH against the session being decided

release_based_axes.RISK_VOL: FRED VIXCLS from the same capture; raw bytes re-derived by collectors/fred_vix_provenance.validate_evidence; ALFRED realtime_start must not be after the capture UTC date; observation_date must not be after realtime_start or after the decided session; never coerced to an ETF session date
release_based_axes.LIQUIDITY: FRED WRESBAL and TOTBKCR from the same capture; derived_payload_sha256 and response hashes must reproduce; realtime_start must not be after the capture UTC date; previous_observation_date < observation_date <= realtime_start and observation_date <= decided session; change must equal value - previous_value

session_rules.calendar: official US session calendar bound by the adoption identity; weekday inference is prohibited (config/regime_source_owner_registry_v2.json markets.US official_calendar)
session_rules.context_session: latest official session whose close is at or before evaluation_at
session_rules.source_window: a capture for session S counts only if S close <= observed_at_utc < close of the next official session and observed_at_utc <= evaluation_at; the latest such capture is used and an invalid latest capture is never replaced by an earlier one
session_rules.expiry: a published decision expires at the close of the official session after its context session
session_rules.chain: accepted historical common-v1 sequence, then one step per official session after history_last_session_date through the context session; a session without a valid capture is an UNDEFINED step

acceptance_record.evaluation: byte-identical canonical output of regime.market_scoped_pit_acceptance.evaluate_market_pit_acceptance('US', bundle); must be PIT_ACCEPTED on every re-evaluation
